summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Vietnamese AI Verification Card landing page. All 7 sections render correctly, all interactive features working as expected, responsive design verified on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports.

Sticky navigation with scroll-spy working correctly
All 6 nav links (hero, game, theory, steps, apply, compare) functional
Hero CTAs scroll to correct sections (game and steps)
All 6 game error highlights (err-1 through err-6) present and clickable
Game dialog opens with error details when clicking highlights
Score increases by 10 points per unique error found
No double-counting: clicking same error twice does not increase score again
Found count displays correctly (X / 6 format)
Progress bar updates as errors are found
Hint button shows toast with next error type
Reset button correctly resets score to 0 and found count to 0
Completion banner appears after finding all 6 errors
Completion banner contains 'Xem 5 bước' button that scrolls to steps section
Both theory cards (practice and truth) visible with Vietnamese content
Desktop: All 5 step triggers (1-5) present and clickable
Desktop: Step detail card updates when clicking different steps
Desktop: Step prev/next buttons navigate correctly with proper disabled states
Desktop: Step complete button toggles completion state
All 5 apply walkthrough tabs (1-5) present and functional
Apply step detail updates when switching tabs
Apply prev/next buttons work with proper disabled boundaries
Before/After comparison cards both visible side-by-side on desktop
Footer replay button scrolls to game section
Footer restart button scrolls to hero section
Mobile: Hamburger menu button opens navigation sheet
Mobile: All 6 mobile nav links present in sheet
Mobile: All 5 step accordions present and functional
Mobile: Before/After cards stack vertically
Vietnamese text renders correctly with proper diacritics
No console errors on page load
All data-testid attributes properly implemented
